regionId.description: Temu region from sites[].regionId; never siteId.

size.description: Items per page; page times size must not exceed 10000.

keyword.description: User keyword; preserve the supplied language.

sort.description: Confirmed provider sort field; omit when unnecessary.

totalSoldMin.description: Lower bound for totalSold; minimum must not exceed maximum.

totalSoldMax.description: Upper bound for totalSold; minimum must not exceed maximum.

itemCountMin.description: Lower bound for itemCount; minimum must not exceed maximum.

itemCountMax.description: Upper bound for itemCount; minimum must not exceed maximum.

mallCountMin.description: Lower bound for mallCount; minimum must not exceed maximum.

mallCountMax.description: Upper bound for mallCount; minimum must not exceed maximum.

avgPriceMin.description: Lower bound for avgPrice; minimum must not exceed maximum.

avgPriceMax.description: Upper bound for avgPrice; minimum must not exceed maximum.

totalSalesMin.description: Lower bound for totalSales; minimum must not exceed maximum.

totalSalesMax.description: Upper bound for totalSales; minimum must not exceed maximum.

catIds.description: Category identifiers obtained from category lookup.

firstOnSaleTimeMin.description: Earliest firstOnSaleTime in ISO-8601 date-time; minimum must not exceed maximum.

firstOnSaleTimeMax.description: Latest firstOnSaleTime in ISO-8601 date-time; minimum must not exceed maximum.
